about.heading: Engineering Ideas Into Digital Models
about.intro: I'm passionate about Civil Engineering, technical drafting, and BIM workflows. My focus is on developing accurate drawings, structured building models, and clear engineering documentation using modern design and analysis software.
story: My journey in Civil Engineering has helped me develop an interest in technical drawing, building modeling, and engineering documentation. Through working with software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, and ETABS, I have been developing my skills across architectural drafting, structural drafting, 3D modeling, quantity estimation, and structural analysis.

I enjoy turning building concepts and technical information into organized drawings and digital models. I am particularly interested in BIM workflows and how accurate models and documentation can support better coordination throughout a building project.

I continue to strengthen my technical knowledge through practice and learning. I am also developing my skills in steel structure fabrication drawings and industrial building drawings using AutoCAD. My goal is to grow as a BIM and Civil Engineering professional while producing clear, accurate, and useful technical work.
